record.question: The Constitution 123rd Amendment Bill 2017 is related to:
record.explanation: Answer C: National Commission for Backward Classes. The Constitution (123rd Amendment) Bill, 2017 proposed constitutional status for the National Commission for Backward Classes. Reference: https://www.pmindia.gov.in/en/news_updates/cabinet-gives-approval-for-introduction-of-constitution-123rd-amendment-bill-2017-and-ncbc-repeal-bill-2017/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
